interface.scope: Driver link speed does not establish measured Internet throughput.

idle_interface_observation.scope: One short passive interval; does not measure other devices on the same router or background traffic at earlier test times.

leigod_user_activation.visibility_limit: No elevation; protected executable paths may be unavailable. A running bound kernel filter does not prove an accelerator session or rate limit is active.

route_observation.scope: An OS TUN default route and physical default route can legitimately coexist; this observation does not establish a conflict.

prior_fast_transfer_shape.four_streams: Each stream ended at the shared 12-second deadline, generally 2.8 to 3.2 MB received.
prior_fast_transfer_shape.interpretation: Similar stream shares are compatible with a common bottleneck; they do not identify a configured limiter. Byte alignment can arise from network/read chunking and does not prove a rate policy.

findings: No measured heavy background traffic in this passive WLAN interval.
No matching Leigod user process/service was observed, while its WLAN binding and kernel driver were enabled.
No public machine/user Windows QoS policy registry was present; ActiveStore could not be inspected without elevation.
These observations do not prove router, Wi-Fi, filter, ISP or overseas-route causation.
next_useful_experiment: One small direct transfer from a domestic HTTPS source through an isolated WLAN-bound direct node, compared with the already measured overseas paths, can separate a general local access bottleneck from an overseas-only one without modifying the active client.
